en: Hold on, {player}! You can't go out there without... Oh? You've got a Pokémon with you!
Well then, have a going-away present. Don't be shy, take it!
When your Pokémon get hurt, take it easy and stop in at a Pokémon Center.
Hold on, {player}! Wild Pokémon live in the grass out there. Don't go without a Pokémon of your own!
Beyond this gate is Route 19. Floccesy Town is a short walk down the hill.
